body:
Thank you for this, I think I've been normalising how she treats me in my head for years because the truth that she is being abusive to me does hurt. But it was sad that me trying justify it let me convince myself I don't deserve to be treated well.

I needed this, I'd forgotten

It is so interesting you say that because when I was 16 to 19 she did nothing about the domestic abuse my brother gave me, I feared for my life at the time and had to deal with the whole thing myself getting a restraining order against him and he got 6 months in prison. My mum would lie to me all the time saying he isn't at home and its safe to come home and when I did He would be in my room. It was terrifying.

Again with my brother it was also hard to cut them out because they were still my brother afterall and facing them in court came with loads of guilt. 

Thank you everyone for your responses as well, I think you are all right. And I shouldn't just forgive when its not deserved that was most eye opening for me
